atlas.pain: City and national government — A government is judged on four things at once — whether the city works, whether the coast is secure, whether the lights come on in a crisis, and whether anyone can prove it afterwards.
atlas.summary: The city, the coast and the crisis on one screen. 5 department modules, each owned and accountable on its own.
modules: Smart City
Streetlights, waste, permits and service requests on one municipal map, each with its service level attached.
Situational Awareness 3D
The city as a navigable 3D scene — sightlines, shadow, elevation and floor-level detail for planning and response.
Emergency Services
Station coverage, response isochrones and live incident load across fire, police and ambulance together.
Maritime
Ports, channels, berths and coastal assets held as a managed operational layer rather than a chart.
Maritime Domain Awareness
Vessel traffic, anchorage behaviour and approach monitoring across the territorial sea.
atlas.practice: 95 hospitals · 201 schools · 94 maritime features · 56 emergency assets
atlas.asks: “Which schools and hospitals fall inside tonight’s flood extent, and who is nearest?”
atlas.resolves: Joins the live layer catalogue to the modelled extent, ranks facilities by exposure, and resolves the nearest response asset that can reach each one.
atlas.guardrail: The agent answers only inside the asking user’s licensed layers and grants — it inherits the interface’s checks, so there is no back door through the assistant.

africa.pain: African Union states and continental agencies — Fifty-four states, the fastest urban growth on earth, and a base-map dependency that has historically been licensed from outside the continent.
africa.summary: Continental scale on open, free base-map data. 9 department modules, each owned and accountable on its own.
modules: Continental Command
The continent at one altitude — 54 states, live sources, a single operating picture.
Food & Agriculture
Cropland, markets, production and food-security signal by administrative unit.
Health & Immunization
Facility catchment, coverage and cold-chain reach measured against population.
Border Management
Crossings, corridors and control posts with movement and constraint.
Port Management
Port capacity, berth state and the hinterland connection behind it.
Land Use & Cover
Continental land-cover change, settlement growth and pressure on protected land.
Parcel Fabric
LADM-aligned tenure where cadastre exists, and the framework for where it does not yet.
Flood & Climate Risk
Exposure by settlement and asset, with live event monitoring on top of it.
Settlement Management
Formal and informal settlement growth against services and infrastructure gap.
africa.practice: 7,379 health facilities · 3,011 markets · 1,285 settlements · 54 AU states
africa.asks: “How many health facilities are in Kenya, and how much can we rely on that?”
africa.resolves: Counts by facility type across the selected country scope, charts the breakdown, and cites the register behind each class.
africa.guardrail: Every count carries an explicit provenance caveat naming the source and its currency — the answer tells you how much to trust it.

terra.pain: Ministries of lands, national registries and cadastral agencies — most occupied land has no registered title, and a national survey is neither affordable nor fast enough to change that.
terra.summary: 2 department modules. Parcel candidates are machine-delineated from imagery and promoted only by a human; BacksightIQ replays a recorded run — not yet a live tenure database.
modules: BacksightIQ
Every parcel event append-only, each entry carrying an inclusion proof against a published root, with a rejection log the operator cannot quietly edit.
Parcel Fabric Development
LADM-aligned cadastral ingest from Esri Parcel Fabric or any ArcGIS FeatureServer — the same live pipeline deployed in One Africa, with candidate review.
terra.practice: Candidate land units, each awaiting a reviewer · BacksightIQ as a recorded run
terra.asks: “Can this parcel’s history be proved to somebody who does not trust the registry?”
terra.resolves: Replays the parcel’s events against a published root, so a bank, a court or a citizen can verify the record independently — without the registry’s cooperation and without BirunIQ running.
terra.guardrail: An AI-segmented boundary is evidence, not title. The lowest rung of the tenure ladder carries no legal effect at all.

sentry.pain: Crisis cells and national response agencies — In a crisis the failure that costs most is not the missed detection.
sentry.summary: Confidence earned, never asserted. 3 department modules, each owned and accountable on its own.
modules: Crisis Command
The active picture during an event — what changed, where, and how confident we are.
Change Detection
Optical, SAR and thermal run as independent detectors; confidence is granted only where they agree.
Incidents
Scored incidents carrying their own evidence and thresholds, with a one-click report.
sentry.practice: Optical · SAR · thermal — confidence earned, not asserted
sentry.asks: “Did anything change at our highest-priority assets overnight?”
sentry.resolves: A background daemon searches the catalogues on a priority-driven interval and runs real optical, SAR and thermal detectors, opening a scored incident when it finds change.
sentry.guardrail: Confidence is a band, never a fabricated percentage — and it is only raised where independent modalities agree. A degraded model cannot invent an incident.

guardian.pain: National security and infrastructure ministries — Civil infrastructure is now a target set.
guardian.summary: A score you can defend in a hearing. 5 department modules, each owned and accountable on its own.
modules: Command & Risk
The estate scored 0–100, decomposed into components an inquiry can interrogate.
Energy Infrastructure
Generation, transmission and fuel assets scored for exposure and consequence.
Utilities & Transport
Water, telecoms, rail and road assets carried in the same risk frame.
Emergency Services
The response capability that would have to answer, mapped against the assets at risk.
Defense & Military
Military and defence-adjacent sites held inside the same protective picture.
guardian.practice: 50 scored sites, every score decomposed · demonstration weights, awaiting an assessing body
guardian.asks: “Which sites carry the highest strike risk, and why those?”
guardian.resolves: Scores 50 curated critical-infrastructure sites 0–100 and ranks them, with the live traffic and collateral picture on the same surface.
guardian.guardrail: The score decomposes in front of you — criticality, exposure and category weight, each shown. The demonstration weights await an assessing body; the decomposition is the product.

floodsurge.pain: A US county’s emergency management office with its floodplain administrator — the response duty and the substantial-damage decision on one map. Demonstration watch area: Washington County, Vermont.
floodsurge.summary: 8 department modules, 6 of them built. Observed Extent has no code yet, and Field Survey has its Field capture forms but no web console. Data from NOAA/NWS, USGS and FEMA public sources.
modules: FloodSurge Command
What needs attention now — gauges by the category the NWS states, forecast crossings, the latest rain, open events and unassessed facilities, led by what is missing.
River Watch
Observed and forecast stage at every gauge, coloured by that gauge’s own NWS flood categories, with a hydrograph for each.
Rain & Streamflow Outlook
MRMS observed rain and WPC forecast precipitation, each with its issue time read from the file. Streamflow on National Water Model reaches is not built.
Observed Extent
Where the water is now, from imagery. No code yet — blocked on two open data-licence items.
Forecast Inundation
The NWS five-day maximum forecast extent, marked as generated by a model, not observed. No depth by hour.
Exposure & Critical Facilities
Flood zones, structures and critical facilities against an extent — and a facility nobody has assessed reads as not assessed.
Events, Alerts & Reports
Events on the shared incident record; priority areas carry county-set threat levels, draw red at Alarm and send email and webhook notices. No SMS.
Field Survey & Substantial Damage
Field-app capture forms only. The web console and the substantial-damage worklist are not built.
floodsurge.practice: Six of eight surfaces built · observed extent not started · NOAA/NWS, USGS and FEMA public sources
floodsurge.asks: “Which gauges are forecast to cross a flood category, and which critical facilities sit inside the forecast extent?”
floodsurge.resolves: Reads each gauge’s NWS forecast against that gauge’s own flood categories, draws the NWS five-day maximum extent, and lists the facilities inside it — leading with the ones nobody has assessed.
floodsurge.guardrail: Derived from NWS data, never an official warning. A forecast extent is marked generated, and a threat level is the county’s own rule, not a probability.

spilltrace.pain: Coastguards, environment ministries and port authorities — the party carrying the coastal duty, which is rarely the party carrying the operating duty.
spilltrace.summary: 9 department modules, all nine with a working console. Detection returns candidates, not confirmed slicks, and every live forecast is labelled simulated until an ocean-forcing feed is connected.
modules: SpillTrace Command
The live incident, where it is predicted to go, and who is in its path — with the parts nobody has assessed shown as unassessed.
Detection
Phase A: dark-patch candidates from a self-hosted Sentinel-1 tiler, called candidates until look-alike screening lands.
Drift & Trajectory
An ensemble, not a line — and a run nobody computed has to say so rather than render an empty envelope.
Receptor Readiness
Desalination intakes, nurseries, landing sites and berths, led by the ones nobody can currently act for.
Escalation & Alerting
Keyed to how long there is to act rather than to severity, with a state that plainly means we cannot say.
Incident Record
What was true and when we knew it — corrections supersede rather than overwrite, enforced at the database.
Shoreline Survey (SCAT)
SCAT segments as surveyed, with the shore nobody has looked at held apart from the shore found clean.
Response Assets & Tasking
Booms, skimmers, vessels and crews against the protection gap. The ensemble optimiser is designed, not built.
Remediation & Waste
Cleanup as a capacity problem — recovered volume against somewhere lawful to put it — and the evidence pack that closes it.
spilltrace.practice: Nine consoles live · detection in phase A · forecasts labelled simulated
spilltrace.asks: “Which receptors does this spill reach first, and which of them can nobody act for?”
spilltrace.resolves: Runs the drift ensemble against the receptor registry and reports arrival by lead time — leading with the receptors that have no response arrangement behind them.
spilltrace.guardrail: A receptor with no data is not a receptor that is safe, and an unwatched sea is not a clean sea. Readiness leads with what is missing.

watchfloor.pain: Defence intelligence and national GEOINT agencies — An all-source watch runs on five consoles and one whiteboard.
watchfloor.summary: One watch floor instead of five consoles. 10 department modules, each owned and accountable on its own.
modules: Watch Floor Command
The standing picture — what is being watched, what changed, and what the floor owes next.
Requirements & RFI
Requests for information triaged against what the organisation already holds, before anything is tasked.
Collection Management
What is asked of each sensor, when, and whether the request was actually satisfied.
Exploitation Workspace
Where an image becomes a judgement — at the claim level the imagery is entitled to support.
Order of Battle
Units, platforms and installations, every attribute resolving to the observation behind it and its age.
Maritime Picture
Surface and sub-surface contacts held on the same floor as everything else.
Air & Space Picture
Air movements and overhead passes, with what each pass could and could not see.
Ground Movement
Vehicle, unit and logistics movement adjudicated against the pattern it departs from.
All-Source Fusion
Imagery, SAR, ADS-B, AIS, field patrol and open reporting reconciled into one entity record.
Production & Dissemination
The report, its Admiralty ratings and its distribution — with an author on every response.
watchfloor.practice: Counted, never scored — 4 entities, 1 unconfirmed >30 d, 1 source silent 11 d
watchfloor.asks: “What changed at this named area, and what is the claim entitled to say?”
watchfloor.resolves: Adjudicates change across optical, SAR, thermal and RF, then drafts the report at the claim level the collection actually supports.
watchfloor.guardrail: Entities are counted, never scored. No composite index is allowed to hide which of its inputs moved.

maritimelens.pain: Navies, coastguards and fisheries enforcement — An exclusive economic zone is enormous, mostly empty, and the traffic that matters is the traffic actively trying not to be seen.
maritimelens.summary: Where AIS stops and SAR starts. 9 department modules, each owned and accountable on its own.
modules: Patrol Command
Every contact in the patrol area, what is known about each — and, plainly, where the sensors cannot see.
Dark Vessels
Positive returns that fail to correlate with any AIS track, kept apart from the ones that could not be adjudicated.
Piracy & Armed Robbery
Incident history and current risk along the routes that carry it.
Trafficking
Narcotics, arms and human-trafficking indicators built from behaviour, not self-report.
IUU Fishing
Fishing effort inside and outside the zones that permit it.
Threat & Force Protection
Threat to own units and to the assets they are protecting.
Patrol Assets
Where the patrol assets are, what they can reach, and in what time.
Maritime Zones
Territorial sea, EEZ and protected zones as enforceable boundaries.
Incident Register
What happened, who adjudicated it, and what followed.
maritimelens.practice: Dark, correlated and un-adjudicated contacts counted apart — and an empty window says it is empty
maritimelens.asks: “Which contacts in the zone are not who they claim to be?”
maritimelens.resolves: Correlates radar and optical returns against AIS, then scores voyage behaviour, flag history and identity against the pattern each vessel departs from.
maritimelens.guardrail: Contacts that could not be adjudicated are kept rigorously apart from dark ones — a sensor gap is not evidence of concealment.

grid.pain: Transmission and distribution operators — A utility is nine departments wearing one logo.
grid.summary: Nine departments that normally buy nine tools. 9 department modules, each owned and accountable on its own.
modules: Grid Command
One executive picture of the network — load, outages, crews and capital work in a single view.
Network & Asset Ops
The connected asset record — substations, feeders, transformers and condition, read from the utility network.
CIP & Major Projects
The capital programme tracked spatially, with schedule from the scheduling system on the same map.
Storm Response
Pre-landfall staging, damage assessment and restoration progress reconciled against the outage management system.
Fleet & Field
Crew and vehicle positions against the work they are assigned, with field capture flowing straight back.
Vegetation
Encroachment risk along circuits, trim cycles, and the spans that actually drive reliability penalties.
Real Estate
Easements, right-of-way, land rights and tenancy attached to every structure on the network.
Environmental
Permits, protected habitat and compliance obligations bound to the assets that trigger them.
Stakeholder
Landowner, regulator and community engagement recorded against the project and the parcel.
grid.practice: Now on the real OpenStreetMap transmission network in England (from 23 Sep); shown here on the US reference build
grid.asks: “Which substations lost redundancy this week, and what work is already against them?”
grid.resolves: Correlates asset, outage and work-order records read from the utility’s own systems of record against the network topology, then ranks by customers at risk.
grid.guardrail: The systems of record stay authoritative. The agent reports what the asset, outage and work-management systems say — it does not restate or overwrite them.

flux.pain: Storage owners, IPPs and power-electronics OEMs — Storage and power conversion are sold together, warranted separately, and operated by people who do not share a system.
flux.summary: Cell to converter to point of interconnection. 9 department modules, each owned and accountable on its own.
modules: Flux Command
The whole chain in one view — what is generated, stored and drawn, and whether balance holds to the next horizon.
Generation & Capture
Every generating asset by type and rating, against what it is actually delivering now.
Storage Fleet
State of charge, dwell and cycling across each site, against the conditions the warranty depends on.
Distribution Paths
Corridor loading against firm capacity, busiest first, with anything above limit flagged.
Demand Centres
Where the draw is, how firm it is, and which contracted peaks are about to be exceeded.
Balance & Forecast
Supply against demand, backward and forward, with the deficit named before it arrives.
Guarantee Ledger
What was promised, what was delivered, and what the shortfall is worth.
Operating Envelope
The warranty conditions, which excursions breached them, and which notice windows are still open.
Revenue vs Degradation
What a cycle earned, set against what it cost the asset.
flux.practice: 1.25 GW headroom · 249 MWh stored · 1 asset not reporting, and it says so
flux.asks: “Does balance hold through the next horizon, and what does it cost the asset?”
flux.resolves: Forecasts supply against demand across the chain and prices each cycle against warranty degradation and the guarantee ledger.
flux.guardrail: An asset that is not reporting is shown as not reporting. One silent unit is never averaged into a comfortable number.

petrocore.pain: Upstream, midstream and terminal operators — An operator carries three exposures on the same asset — integrity, emissions and security.
petrocore.summary: Integrity, emissions and security on one asset record. 9 department modules, each owned and accountable on its own.
modules: PetroCore Command
Integrity, emissions and security on one asset record instead of three.
Petroleum Facilities
The estate that matters most, and what it is exposed to.
Pipeline Integrity
Right-of-way condition, encroachment, ground movement and third-party interference along the line.
Change Monitoring
What changed on or near the asset between epochs, with the detector named.
Marine & Tanker
Vessel movements against the terminal and the berths they are working.
Ignis · Process Safety
Protective state over plant geometry — detection, suppression, containment and escape, each bound to its basis.
Pre-Incident Plans
Per-location fire suppression plans on the ground they defend — tier, product, foam and cooling demand, tactical objectives, and the plan document itself.
Inspection Reports
Findings, severity and closure — including the measures still unverified.
Predictive Risk
Where integrity or safety is most likely to be lost next.
petrocore.practice: Every analysis bound to the basis it was computed from — advisory, never a safety decision
petrocore.asks: “Where is integrity most likely to be lost along this line?”
petrocore.resolves: Fuses InSAR ground motion, right-of-way encroachment, third-party interference and inspection history into a ranked segment list.
petrocore.guardrail: Every analysis is bound to the basis it was computed from, and is advisory only — never a safety decision.

tower.pain: Airport authorities and operators — An airport is two businesses on one piece of land: a movement area governed by safety regulation, and a property portfolio governed by revenue.
tower.summary: Airside and landside, one picture. 10 department modules, each owned and accountable on its own.
modules: Air Traffic
Movement areas, approach corridors and traffic load rendered over the live airfield.
Surface Condition
Pavement condition, contamination, friction and closures across runway, taxiway and apron.
Tarmac Lighting
Every fixture, circuit and outage on the airfield lighting system, with maintenance state.
Lane Striping
Markings inventory, wear and repaint scheduling across movement and non-movement areas.
Signage
Guidance and mandatory instruction signs with their compliance and legibility status.
Property Lease
Every leasehold, concession and parcel on airport land, with term, revenue and obligation.
Major Projects
Capital works on the airfield, phased against operational impact and closure windows.
Emergency Services
ARFF coverage, response routes and hot-spot readiness across the aerodrome.
Vehicle Traffic
Landside and airside vehicle movement, gate load and incursion risk.
Weather
Live conditions over the airfield, joined to surface condition and operational restriction.
tower.asks: “Which movement areas are due for inspection before the next peak?”
tower.resolves: Scores airfield features by condition history, traffic loading and time since last inspection, and sequences the work into the available windows.
tower.guardrail: Airside safety decisions stay with the authority. The output is a prioritised list, never a clearance.

milepost.pain: State and national transport departments — A DOT is accountable at two altitudes at once: a commissioner answering for a multi-year capital programme, and a crew answering for today’s lane closure.
milepost.summary: Executive overview first, then drill to the crew. 10 department modules, each owned and accountable on its own.
modules: Executive Overview
The whole programme at commissioner altitude — spend, schedule and condition by district.
Pavement Management
Condition index by segment, deterioration curves, and the treatment that is actually due.
Facility Management
Depots, salt sheds, rest areas and buildings managed as a single estate.
Lane Striping
Marking retroreflectivity, wear and the repaint programme by route.
Live Traffic
Current speed, volume and incident state across the whole network.
Roadwork & Obstructions
Every active closure, lane restriction and permit on the road at the same time.
Major Projects
Capital delivery tracked spatially, with schedule and stakeholder exposure attached.
Crew Status
Where the crews are, what they are assigned, and what they have completed today.
Snow Removal & Treatment
Route coverage, material usage and pass completion during a live event.
Emergency Response
Incident command over the roadway, with detour and closure control.
milepost.asks: “Which projects are slipping, and is it cost, schedule or scope?”
milepost.resolves: Rolls project health up to portfolio level and decomposes every red flag into the specific metric that caused it.
milepost.guardrail: No aggregate without its parts — each roll-up drills straight to the project record it was computed from.

blueprint.pain: Owners, programme managers and contractors — Capital delivery fails in the gap between design and ground.
blueprint.summary: Constructability before the ground is broken. 9 department modules, each owned and accountable on its own.
modules: Portfolio View
Every capital project on one map with status, spend and schedule health.
Design Status
Design maturity by package and discipline, tied to the site it belongs to.
Site Selection
Candidate sites compared against access, utilities, hazard and constraint before commitment.
Constructability Review
Buildability risk read in 3D before design freeze — clash, access, laydown and sequence.
Environmental & Cultural
Protected habitat, heritage and permit constraints bound to the project footprint.
Construction Inspections
Inspection records, defects and hold points captured in the field, located exactly.
Safety Report
Incidents, near-misses and hazards mapped to the work area that produced them.
Stakeholder Mgmt & Access
Landowner, neighbour and authority engagement against the parcel and the programme.
Live Traffic
Haul routes and public impact modelled against the active work zone.
blueprint.asks: “Which sites changed since the last inspection, and does that match reported progress?”
blueprint.resolves: Compares imagery epochs against the reported construction schedule and surfaces the divergence, site by site.
blueprint.guardrail: Progress remains the inspector’s judgement. The AI supplies the discrepancy, not the verdict.

harvest.pain: Ministries of agriculture and food security — A ministry has to state national production before the harvest is in, and defend the number afterwards.
harvest.summary: Seven surfaces, resolved live. 7 department modules, each owned and accountable on its own.
modules: Harvest Command
The national crop picture for a ministry — area, condition and outlook in one view.
Crop Type & Land Use
What is planted where, resolved from Sentinel-2 rather than taken on declaration.
Crop Health
Vigour and stress by field, through the season rather than at the end of it.
Yield Forecast
Expected production against area and condition, updated as the season runs.
Water & Drought
Moisture deficit, irrigation demand and drought exposure by district.
Field Boundaries & Registry
The field fabric itself — boundaries, holders and registry linkage.
Risk & Finance
Insurance, credit and subsidy exposure attached to the field it was written against.
harvest.practice: Seven surfaces resolved live from Sentinel-2 · Kenya & Nigeria
harvest.asks: “What will this season yield, and where is the risk concentrated?”
harvest.resolves: Resolves crop type, canopy health, water stress and a season-NDVI yield proxy live from Sentinel-2, by region, crop and season.
harvest.guardrail: Forecasts ship with an honest inter-annual uncertainty band — never a single confident number a ministry will later be held to.

greenscope.pain: Environmental regulators and ESG-accountable operators — Environmental regulation is an evidence problem.
greenscope.summary: The regulator’s side of the table. 8 department modules, each owned and accountable on its own.
modules: Environmental Command
The portfolio compliance picture — and the records the numbers cannot see, stated on the board.
Inspection Reports
Findings by severity and topic, with corrective actions, overdue tracking and recurrence.
Permitting
Conditions, expiries and obligations bound to the asset that triggers them.
Biodiversity & Habitat
Protected habitat and species constraints on the same map as the work.
Habitat Change
What the habitat did between epochs — adjudicated, not asserted.
Groundwater
Aquifer condition, abstraction and contamination pathways below the site.
Soil Intelligence
Soil condition and contamination, sampled and interpolated with its uncertainty carried.
Predictive Risk
Where the next finding is most likely, from the pattern of the ones already closed.
greenscope.practice: Every board states its own denominator — what was counted, what was excluded, and why
greenscope.asks: “Where is the next compliance finding most likely to land?”
greenscope.resolves: Learns from closed findings to rank sites by the likelihood, topic and severity of the next issue, against permit conditions and habitat constraints.
greenscope.guardrail: The board states its own denominator — records that are not approved are excluded, counted, and shown beside the number they did not enter.
